customer_insurance.value: Works with customers' insurance companies when the vehicle is going to G.L.O. Auto Repair, the body shop Yordan works with
customer_insurance.source: Yordan, comment on the site report, 2026-10-14: 'yes but only if going to a body shop' (asked: do you work with insurance companies or roadside plans?); narrowed by Yordan to G.L.O. only on a decision card, 2026-10-15 ('Only G.L.O.' rather than 'Any shop')
customer_insurance.note: No insurers or roadside plans were named, so the site names none and doesn't mention roadside plans. On 2026-10-15 Yordan wrote 'we take your insurance if you do it through the body shop service', and on a decision card the same day Yordan said only tows to G.L.O. qualify, so the site names G.L.O. A tow to another shop the customer picks is still fine, without insurance billing.
customer_insurance.used_in: content/faq.json, 'Do you work with insurance companies?'

body_shop_partner.source: Yordan in the website thread, 2026-10-14: 'I work with a body shop and we provide body shop service too ... It's not owned by me. Auto Repair - Taller de Chapa y Pintura' in Cape Coral and lists 24/7 towing in partnership with ALEJO'S TOWING INC (read 2026-10-15).

body_shop_partner.bundle: Yordan, 2026-10-15: wants the tow and the G.L.O. repair shown as one offer ('kind of do like a bundle deal, like probably maybe lower prices if you do your body shop with this, or we take your insurance if you do it through the body shop service'), kept formal and professional. No set discount was given, so the site promises no prices or savings; add one only with Yordan's exact terms.
body_shop_partner.used_in: content/faq.json, 'Do you work with a body shop?' and 'Do you work with insurance companies?'; content/services.json, accident recovery, "partner" panel
